summary: Define governed skill execution handoff contracts

delivery.outcome: Portable data-only execution handoffs bind governed repository plans to external exact grants, terminal receipts and canonical errors without granting or executing authority.
nonGoals: Execute repository, forge or OneDev mutations
Allow an LLM to produce a grant, target, command or receipt
Change the existing wellmanifest skills v1 definition and selection contract

architecture.decision: Add a companion skill-execution handoff family that carries only exact references and digests; authority remains external and runtime-specific execution remains in Subactor.
interfaceChanges: Introduce wellmanifest.skill-execution-plan/v1, grant-binding/v1, terminal-receipt/v1 and execution-error/v1
dataChanges: Add stable repository operation IDs and canonical execution error records
architecture.rollback: Remove the companion execution handoff artifacts and their call from bundled conformance; the existing Skill DSL v1 remains unchanged.
